tools.name: search_episodes
tools.description: Search Chiikawa episodes by words, scenes or feelings in any language (e.g. 'Hachiware cries', '草むしり検定'). Episodes whose title or summary contains the words come first, then ones close in meaning.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get one episode by its post id or its manga episode number: title, date, summary, characters, arc and links.

tools.name: get_character
tools.description: A character's profile in the catalog: number of posts, first and latest appearance, who they appear with most, and their most typical episodes. The name may be in any language (e.g. ハチワレ, Hachiware, 小八).

tools.name: list_arcs
tools.description: All multi-part story arcs with their number of episodes.

tools.name: get_arc
tools.description: One story arc: its chapters and episodes in order.

tools.name: draft_error_report
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 for privately telling the site operator about a factual error in one episode's page (one point per report). tools.name: send_confirmed_error_report
tools.description: Step 2 of 2: send a draft from draft_error_report after the user has seen that exact draft and the terms, said to send it, and agreed to the terms. Never call it on your own.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_episode, get_character · Private data: draft_error_report · Public sink: get_episode, send_confirmed_error_report · Destructive: draft_error_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_episode, get_character · Private data: draft_error_report · Public sink: get_episode, send_confirmed_error_report · Destructive: draft_error_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
